objective: G3 and G16: after arbitrary reuse of the Boolean padding that used to make implication clauses strict, determine whether reorganizing the choices still makes decision easy with zero or one shared middle identity.
status: Complete: Arbitrarily many shared hidden padding choices admit linear-time ordinary satisfiability with at most one repeated positive middle name. Some two-stage inputs become contradictory only after both kinds of sharing occur.
title: A linear cut scan with shared hidden padding
